text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Although Brick can work as a supplementary damage source, she is relatively frail and generally superseded in that role by Everspark later on, due to having less range. Instead, she finds more success by supporting numerous smaller troops with Battle Orders to dramatically boost the attacking force' DPS. Notable examples include Laser Rangers and Zookas.
Brick should not be used with Tanks, as they tend to put her in the line of fire, and don't make much out of her bonuses with how much space they take.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Each upgrade increases Sgt. Brick's hitpoints by 8%, DPS by 10% and Grenade damage by 8.2%; level 22 to 23's increments are slightly larger than these.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Like with other Heroes, Sgt. Brick's death sound is not unique. In her case, she shares the same death sound with the Rifleman.
Sgt. Brick, along with the Cryoneer are voice acted by Marissa Lenti.
Sgt. Brick is the Hero with the highest level cap.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: The critters that the hero spawns can be useful for distracting single-target defenses like Boom Cannons as long as there are no splash defenses such as Flamethrowers nearby.
As she has the longest range out of all heroes, she is more compatible for Tank-based armies. Unlike Brick, she can comfortably stay behind Tanks which means she is less vulnerable to enemy fire.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Buildings like Flamethrowers, Hot Pots or Shock Blasters can quickly take care of the critters, leaving Cpt. Eversparks alone.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Each upgrade increases Cpt. Everspark's hitpoints by 6%, damage per second by 6%, and increases Critter spawn rate by reducing time to spawn by 0.1 seconds.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Everspark's description implies her mother is Colonel Gearheart.
When Everspark is attacking a building at low levels, she will attack two times before spawning critters, but at higher levels this changes to one attack per cycle.
The outcome of this change is a loss in dps equivalent to somewhere between 8 to 9 levels

Because of this, despite the game implying othwerise, Everspark is in fact the Hero with the lowest actual damage per second (obviously excluding Dr. Kavan), despite her supposed dps being the second highest. She does keep the second highest damage per shot among Heroes.
The real damage per second of a level 19 Everspark is lower than her real dps at levels 11 and 12.
This makes level 12 the level where Everspark deals the most damage per second.
https://boombeach.fandom.com/wiki/File:Everspark_HQ_Hack.mp4Like beam shooter troops, Cpt. Everspak's attacks do not have travel time, and instantly damage the target.

It is possible to hack the HQ via Universal Remote. To do so, Cpt. Everspark must use her Universal Remote at the same time as the targeted defense is being destroyed. In this case, Cpt. Everspark can hack the HQ if it is within her range.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: As a support type hero, Dr. Kavan is arguably the most versatile. He is essentially a stronger Medic, and works well in strategies that already include them.
Unlike Sgt. Brick, Cpt. Everspark and Pvt. Bullit, Dr. Kavan's Hero Abilities can be used while inside a Smoke Screen. This can come in handy when Smoke Screens are in use.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Most upgrades increase Dr. Kavan's hitpoints by 6%, heal per second by 4%, and damage reduction percentage point by 0.3%. The level 19 stats increase considerably from level 18.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Dr. Kavan is voice acted by Brian Stivale.
According to the dialogue said by Lt. Hammerman when destroying Hammerman's HQ, Dr. Kavan was forced to sign an non-disclosure agreement.
Dr. Kavan is the only hero mentioned in another Skin, the Phoenix Skin from the Scorcher.
Aside from Dr. Kavan, the Admiral is the only character in game who wears any sort of power stones.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Bullit is best used as a short-ranged DPS-Tank hybrid. His Pain Tolerance Hero Perk is weak against rapid-firing area defenses like Flamethrowers and Shock Blasters, but dangerous point defenses like Doom Cannons stand no chance as most of their damage will be dismissed. His Taunt ability can also help in this regard and distract defenses from attacking Heavies, Tanks, Scorchers, and Mechs.

Bases where the Headquarters is not adequately protected are particolarly vulnerable to Bullit solos, as his high DPS and survivability, coupled with Energy Drink allow him to survive multiple sources of damage as he continuously depletes the Headquarters' HP.
As Pvt. Bullit fires faster at lower health you may want to keep him at low HP for as long as possible before using his Energy Drink to maximize the amount of damage dealt to the Headquarters.
Destroying unprotected support buildings (with Bullit or Critters) allows for more energy to use for the Headquarters solo, on top of slightly reducing the Headquarters' HP.
If the Headquarters survives with low HP the rest of the army only needs to destroy a few buildings to deplete the rest.

Bunkers with Cryoneers should be avoided as they halve movement and attack speed, unless your Bullit has enough health to exploit a Flamethrower's burn damage to fire at normal speed; Bunkers with Grenadiers can be exploited to deal additional damage to the Heaquarters and defenses around it. Similarly, bases with the Mind Control Engraving can potentially spawn a lot of small units to distract him.

If Bullit is surrounded by many Critters he won't retarget fast enough to quickly kill them. Dropping Artillery directly onto him will usually help, as he can tank its damage while the splash nukes the Critters.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Shock Blaster is a very effective defense as it not only bypasses the Hero Perk but also prevents abilities like Taunt or Energy Drink from activating.
The Headquarters should always be thoroughly protected to prevent Pvt. Bullit from single handedly winning the attack.

Shield Generators, Shock Blasters, Grapplers and Shock Launchers provide the best protection against this strategy. Shock Launchers alone are generally not enough as their limited HP makes them easy to take out with minimal Gunboat Energy expenses.
Mind Control, Overheat and Support are the strongest Engravings against Bullit solos.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual differences, but each upgrade increases his hitpoints (by 8%), damage per second (by 10%), and reduces the damage limit on his Pain Tolerance (by 100 until level 11, then 50 for following levels).

text.title: Интересное
lines: He has the highest hitpoints and DPS of all Heroes.
While under the effects of the best Troop Health Masterpiece, 12 Guardians (all boosted with Power Powder), a maxed Pvt. Bullit has 269,192 health.

If the opponent also has the best Troop Health Masterpiece and 12 Guardians (all boosted with Power Powder), and the player attacks using the Engraving Intel at max level, a maxed Pvt. Bullit can have up to 377,188 health.
'Private' is the lowest military rank, and also the lowest known rank in the game.
Contrary to the game's description, he has been promoted several times, though each time his attitude led to him celebrating and doing something that ended up demoting him.
If you look closely, Bullit already has an Energy Drink bottle attached to his belt, but oddly, he still needs Gunboat energy to use it and still has it even when using other abilities.

Pvt. Bullit shares many similarities with Bull from Brawl Stars, another Supercell game. Both are very tanky, both wield triple barreled shotguns, both are short ranged, both have bull themed belt buckles and both have the ability to increase their fire rate when low on health.
Pvt. Bullit is the only projectile-firing unit with hitscan attacks that reach his target before it visually connects.
Pvt. Bullit has the lowest level cap among Heroes, despite being unlocked earlier than Cpt. Ruddero.
When leveling up to level 7 all his abilities gain 1 level. This is the only time in the game where a Hero increases the maximum level of all his abilities in a single level up.
Pvt. Bullit and Sgt. Koa (at Talent 5) are the only units in the entire game to possess a maximum damage limit to their health, meaning they may never perish in a single attack.

Without Magma statues to increase his health, Pvt. Bullit will never be defeated in less than 9 attacks at level 1; at maximum level he'll never be defeated in less than 67 attacks. This also means that his minimum durability at maximum level is 7.44 times higher than at level 1.

If Energy Drink, Leech and Health bonuses from Mega Crab are not taken into consideration, Pvt. Bullit has a "maximum minimum" durability of 337 hits with 13 maximum Boosted Troop Health Magma Statues; with Intel and attacking a player with 13 lit maximum power Troop Health statues, Pvt. Bullit has a "maximum minimum" durability of 472 hits. Note that with those conditions each maximum level Energy Drink will add 168 to 169 hits to his minimum durability in the first case, and 235 to 236 hits in the 2nd case.

Assuming if Taunt is permanently active, an unboosted level 1 Bullit will never go down in less than 60 hits; As for the opposite case that number is increased to 11,167 hits without Intel, and a staggering 15,028 hits with Intel, making Private Bullit virtually impossible to defeat in the duration of a 4 minute battle. Assuming if all shots connect, it takes 3 minutes and 53.8 seconds for 6 Machine Guns continuously firing to take down a Level 14 Health Pvt, Bullit with a permanently active level 7 Taunt.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Cpt. Ruddero is a purely supportive Hero, akin to Sgt. Brick, with the Bombing Run ability carrying most of his damage potential. As such, he operates best with cover from Heavy Choppas in Warships when possible, or with other durable units in the home base.
His Wingmen can occasionally dismiss attacks from enemy point defenses, such as Boom Cannons, which does help compensate for his fragility, but should not be relied upon.
Because Cpt. Ruddero himself has very low durability, he should always remain behind stronger units. Allowing enemy defenses to target him directly will usually result in a quick elimination.

Bombing Run can be used to weaken clusters of defenses or clear support buildings before the main force reaches them. Timing the ability just before units enter defensive range can reduce incoming damage significantly.
Pairing him with durable front-line units such as Heavys, Scorchers, or Heavy Choppas allows him to stay alive long enough to repeatedly use his perk throughout the attack.

Cpt. Ruddero should not be considered a replacement for Cpt. Everspark. While his Wingmen provide a similar supportive function, they behave very differently from Critters. Cpt. Ruddero can have a maximum of 6 Wingmen orbiting him, whereas Cpt. Everspark can have up to 12 Critters on the battlefield at once. Unlike Wingmen, Critters are ground units that move forward across the battlefield and can enter defensive blind spots, though they can also be targeted by nearly all defenses. Wingmen instead circle around Cpt. Ruddero and can only be targeted by defenses capable of attacking air units.

Their abilities also differ significantly: Wingman Rush deploys up to 6 Wingmen at a time, while Cpt. Everspark's Critter Swarm summons a large amount of Critters. Additionally, the strength of the Wingmen scales with Cpt. Ruddero's ability level, as each ability level increases the Wingmen level by 1.

However, Wingmen are generally more durable than Critters in several situations. They are immune to all types of mines since they are aerial units, allowing them to safely pass over minefields that would otherwise eliminate large numbers of Critters instantly. They also spread out more naturally while orbiting Cpt. Ruddero, meaning they do not cluster together as tightly as Critters often do. In addition, they possess significantly higher durability at higher levels, with around 600 HP compared to the roughly 400 HP of Critters, making them less vulnerable to splash damage. However, Wingmen can also have less health when Wingman Rush is level 4 or lower.

Due to their lower limit of only 6 Wingmen, they are particularly vulnerable to high-damage point defenses such as Cannons, Boom Cannons, and Doom Cannons. Furthermore, the fact that the Wingmen orbit around Cpt. Ruddero can lead to situations where defenses lock onto Cpt. Ruddero if the remaining Wingman happens to be positioned behind him at that moment.

The Wingman Rush ability is also relatively cheap to use, starting at only 3 Gunboat Energy and increasing by just 3 with each subsequent use. This low cost allows players to deploy Wingmen frequently during an attack, providing consistent distraction and defensive fire absorption over time.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Cpt. Ruddero relies heavily on staying protected behind other units, making him vulnerable if exposed. Defensive layouts that quickly eliminate supporting troops will often leave him defenseless.
High-damage point defenses such as boom Cannons and Doom Cannons can quickly eliminate Cpt. Ruddero if he becomes exposed, as his health pool is relatively small.
Defenses that eliminate front-line units quickly are particularly effective, as they expose Cpt. Ruddero to direct fire much earlier in the battle.
Because much of his impact comes from Bombing Run, spreading out important defenses can reduce the effectiveness of the ability and prevent multiple structures from being damaged at once.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Cpt. Ruddero was first introduced in Warships Season 64, 66 and 68, before being made available in the Home Base after Season 72.

Cpt. Ruddero's properties and artwork are derived from Jetpack, a unit in the now-defunct Space Ape spinoff, Boom Beach: Frontlines. His name, however, appeared as a message in a bottle as early as 2017.
Interestingly, Cpt. Ruddero has received a slight overhaul for his icon and model. The insignia on his helmet has been simplified, with the Artillery shell being rotated and losing its wings.
Before Cpt. Ruddero was added to the main base, he recycled Jetpack's artwork from Boom Beach: Frontlines.
Cpt. Ruddero has three other letters that were written later chronologically:
"We were caught in a storm and ended up in an uncharted corner of the sea. There's a chain of islands in a triangular shape."
"Impossible to escape this maddening place. Come quickly, or my crew may resort to desperate measures!"
"Only myself, the bosun and the cook left now. We'll set sail one more time, aiming along the hypotenuse. Wish us luck!"
As Cpt. Ruddero is unlocked very late in the game, he has several characteristics that make him unique among Heroes:
He has 2 Abilities unlocked at level 1.
He has the most level upgrades from the moment he's unlocked, being able to reach level 14 at Headquarters level 24.
That also makes him the only Hero whose perks can all be upgraded up to level 5 at the same Headquarters level he's unlocked.

Cpt. Ruddero gains access to level 7 abilities the latest, at Headquarters level 28, while other Heroes start gaining access at HQ level 25 (Sgt. Brick and Cpt. Everspark) and 26 (Dr. Kavan and Pvt. Bullit).
He's also the only Hero to only have a single level 7 ability at HQ 28, while all other Heroes have 2.
